# glinet_firewall_redirect (Resource)

Manage one firewall redirect (destination NAT). The home-network policy rejects unmanaged redirects; a redirect declared by this resource is treated as managed. Destroy releases ownership by default.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Unique redirect name.

### Optional

- `delete_behavior` (String) Destroy behavior. `forget` releases Terraform ownership and preserves the UCI section; `delete` removes a Terraform-created named section. Firmware-owned anonymous sections are always preserved.
- `dest` (String) Destination zone.
- `dest_ip` (String) Internal destination address.
- `dest_port` (String) Internal destination port.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the redirect is active.
- `proto` (String) Protocol.
- `reflection` (Boolean) Enable NAT reflection.
- `src` (String) Source zone.
- `src_dport` (String) Source destination port.
- `target` (String) Target, normally DNAT.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stable import identifier.
- `uci_section` (String) Resolved UCI section name on the router.
